notes.title: Maps & Hazards
notes.content:
It's been a couple months since the Balance Update, and now I'm happy to announce the new Maps & Hazards update is ready to go live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992417/6e001df659516bac9f0cb180aaa18859dfe240d2.png[/img]

Change log: 

[list]

[*] [b]Art Overhaul![/b]

Many places in the game have updated art, textures and ambient effects.

[*] [b]Cavern, Volcano, Factory, Graveyard and Ice Field maps all now have hazards![/b]

After a a small amount of time, something will occur on the maps that cause danger to the players.

Cavern - A earthquake will start and a large boulder will fall from the ceiling, creating an AoE explosion.

Volcano - The center of the map will erupt, punching a hole through the map.

Factory - At half time, the fuse box in the factory will overload, causing the electric fences to form around the center platform.

Ice Field - An avalanche will occasionally occur. Dropping Blizzard Bombs from the side of the cliff.

Graveyard - Ghosts will spawn at regular intervals, that stun the player on hit.

[*] [b]The amount of spells in a Spell Book has now been reduced from 5 to 3.[/b]

This was done to more easily allow players to swap and combo spells. As changing from 3 secondaries proved to be too cumbersome to be useful. Now instead of each secondary having it's own button mapped to swap spells, there is a quick swap button. Switching between the two secondaries chosen.

[*] [b]The Spellbook Achieve overhaul![/b]

The Spellbook Archive is now it's own interactable arena where the player can walk around, swap and edit Spellbooks, fight against training dummies and purchase hints with a new in game currency!

Just speak to the book keeper at the back!

[*] [b]Carnage Balance tweaks[/b]

You now start with 5 lives as opposed to 3 for the entirety of Carnage mode, bosses have had there DMG output lowered and HP reduced as too streamline the process of grinding out achievements and unlocks.

[*] [b]Instants, Concentration and Channeled[/b] 

Spells are now divided into 3 categories. Primaries and Secondaries can now be used at the same time.

Instants - Can be used at anytime in conjunction with another spell.
(Example: Using Fire Ball and Ice Shard at the same time)

Concentration - Can be used at anytime in conjunction with an instant spell, but not another concentration spell. Usually spells that must charge up to be used.
(Example: Using Flamethrower and Fire Ball is allowed, but not Flamethrower and Wind Arrow)

Channeled - Can only be used by itself and disallows the user to cast any other spells while spell is active. These are usually powerful spells with high mana costs.
(Example: Charging Arcane Cannon.)

[*] [b]PvP Teams![/b] 

Team battles have now been introduced! Both locally and online.
User can swap between 3 teams, No Team, Red Team or Blue Team.

[/list]

+ TONS of bug and crash fixes.


Passive Abilities have been delayed to a later patch, mostly due to this update being as large as it is.
More fixes to come as the bugs show themselves.

Hope you enjoy!

[i]- Colton LaChance[/i]

notes.title: The Balance - Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Fix issue where key was being mapped to the wrong button on keyboard.

The Swap Spell button was registering as "T" rather than "TAB" as the tutorial stated.

notes.title: THE BALANCE - UPDATE
notes.content:
[u][i]The first milestone on MagiCarnage's roadmap has been released![/i][/u]

[h1]THE BALANCE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992417/a271253404c166d5753b059327f373ea468175d2.png[/img]

Many changes have been made to the game, primarily quality of life improvements and spell balancing. 

Anyways, without farther ado, here's the change log!



[list]
[*] A Training mode has been added, allowing players to replay the tutorial
[*] 8 new skins have been added, along with 8 new achievements
[*] Spell slots have been reduced from 5 to 3, to make Spellbooks feel more impactful and easier to use
[*] A quick spell change button has been added
[*] GUI now shows Primary mana charges
[*] Implemented Random Spellbooks & Maps

[*] Player spawn effect and sound now appears on death
[*] Charge based spells now use mana before, rather than on fire

[*] Fixed Death position bug for Geomancer and Technomancer
[*] Fixed issue where being slowed while quickened would remove slow status
[*] Fixed depth issues with Arcane Beam / Arcane Ball
[*] Fixed UI selection bug in Spellbook Archive when navigating with Keyboard/Controller

[*] Buffed Arcane Ball

[*] Nerfed Shuriken DMG
[*] Nerfed Geomancer DMG
[*] Nerfed Fire Bomb DMG
[*] Nerfed Vortex size, pull and DMG

[*] Fixed crash on title when unlocking something

[*] Plenty of polish and various other bugfixes everywhere

[/list]

[h3]Have any ideas?[/h3]

notes.title: General bug fixes & Balancing
notes.content:
[h3]Did some patchwork in the form of debugging & balancing.[/h3]

 - Buffed Air Blast's knockback

- Nerfed Geomancer over all Damage output
- Nerfed Arcane Beam's Damage & Mana Cost

- Fixed bug with controls snapping back to the right when stick is let go
- Fixed bug where on fall in Minigame map, player would never respawn
- Fixed bug where player would get Game Over for losing minigame

- Fixed some Spell descriptions

notes.title: Early Access OUT NOW! + Roadmap & Discord
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992417/4e0e58a568419b1e8dc7283c53b85d9be33e516e.png[/img]

[h3]Finally![/h3]
It's been 5 years since I started playing with the idea of MagiCarnage, and now after 4 test iterations, plenty of burnouts, and a dozen or so other concepts, it's finally here!

[h3]Aside from the release, I have 2 other announcements to make.[/h3]

[h2]ROAD MAP[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992417/babbaaa095d93c320c79230e990b8d07106524e3.png[/img]

Here is the first Roadmap outlining the future of MagiCarnage! The first update coming within the next month or so, and every other update coming approximately every 2-3 months after.


If there are any changes to this roadmap I'll be sure to make an announcement and create a new updated one.

[h2]DISCORD SERVER[/h2]

Although the server itself is still a WIP, over time I will be getting moderators and programming server commands and features. 

Feel free to join and discuss! I'm always open to suggestions, and would appreciate the user feedback.

[h3][url=https://discord.gg/bw3AzEk6DK]Here's the link![/url][/h3]
